title: Feedback section, composition
question: The roll assigned Single Plate Quote. Lock a structure for the Feedback section (Monograph world stays).

options.label: Single Plate Quote
options.lineage: One monograph plate owns the spread, visitor advances through client voices
options.thesis: One testimonial at full plate scale: large quote type, caption rail with name/place, previous/next as quiet plate turns.
options.viewport: Full-width quote as the only voice. Name · place in the bottom rail. Prev / Next as text controls, no cards, no avatar grid.
options.risk: Fewer quotes visible at once; depth beats skim.

options.label: Errata Strip
options.lineage: Horizontal errata / caption strip under the section title
options.thesis: Quotes scroll sideways as a continuous caption film, skim many voices without card tiles.
options.viewport: Title left. A ruled horizontal track of quotes; drag or arrows. Each panel is text only, no boxes.
options.risk: Horizontal scroll can hide proof on mobile if not well signposted.

options.label: Name Index
options.lineage: Monograph index, names as entries, quote as the opened page
options.thesis: Left: vertical index of client names. Right: the active quote at reading size. Selection is the interaction.
options.viewport: Names stacked flush-left. Active name in full ink weight. Quote fills the right field with place as caption.
options.risk: Needs clear keyboard/focus states so it stays operable.

canonCard.label: Category standard
canonCard.thesis: 2×2 testimonial cards with quote + name, the default every studio ships.
canonCard.viewport: Grid of four identical quote blocks.
